name: Coming back to God
promise: Six days for anyone who has drifted, on admitting the loss, facing the idols, and being drawn back to the first altar.
why: Drifting rarely happens in a day. It happens while we sleep, while other loves quietly take God's place, until one day we notice how far we are from the fire we once had. The good news of these six sessions is that the way back is open: a woman who admitted she slept, a David who pursued and recovered all, an Abraham whom God led back to his first altar. If you have drifted, you are not disqualified. Come back, step by step, and let Him revive His work in you.

days.theme: Admitting the loss: the way back begins
days.key_quote: Your Maker can remake you; your Maker can repackage you.

days.theme: Idols in the heart: the real reason we drift
days.key_title: An Idol Fights for His Place
days.key_quote: When that idol is erected, that idol fights with the place of God.

days.theme: Drawn back: His love does the pursuing
days.key_quote: It is that drawing that makes you pursue.

days.key_title: The Altar He Made at First
days.key_quote: God led him back to the place of the altar which he had made at the first.

days.theme: Bought with a price: consecration again
days.key_quote: I am bought, so I'm no longer my own.

days.theme: Revive Your work in the midst of the years
days.key_quote: Every time God wants to revive his works in the land, he begins by reviving the altar of prayer.
